summary: Eupraxia Pharmaceuticals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, attaching a notice of annual general meeting and management information circular for a meeting scheduled on June 18, 2026. The agenda includes receiving audited financial statements, setting board size at seven, electing directors, and appointing an auditor. The meeting is virtual-only. This is a routine annual meeting notice, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, activist campaign, or strategic review is present. The filing is purely administrative and procedural.
